segments.sn46.56:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
segments.sn46.56:1.3: Atha kho abhayo rājakumāro yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho abhayo rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn46.56:1.6: Ahetu, appaccayo [appaccayā (sī.), appaccayaṃ (?)] aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hoti.
segments.sn46.56:1.7: Natthi hetu, natthi paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya.
segments.sn46.56:1.10: “Atthi, rājakumāra, hetu, atthi paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya.
segments.sn46.56:1.11: Sahetu, sappaccayo [sappaccayā (sī.), sappaccayaṃ (?)] aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hoti.
segments.sn46.56:1.12: Atthi, rājakumāra, hetu, atthi paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya.
segments.sn46.56:2.1: “Katamo pana, bhante, hetu, katamo paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya?
segments.sn46.56:2.2: Kathaṃ sahetu, sappaccayo aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hotī”ti?
segments.sn46.56:2.3: “Yasmiṃ kho, rājakumāra, samaye kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena, uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati – ayampi kho, rājakumāra, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya.
segments.sn46.56:2.5: Evampi sahetu sappaccayo aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hoti.
segments.sn46.56:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, rājakumāra, yasmiṃ samaye byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati byāpādaparetena … pe … thinamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena … uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhitena … vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena, uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ na jānāti na passati – ayampi kho, rājakumāra, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo aññāṇāya adassanāya.
segments.sn46.56:3.6: Evampi sahetu sappaccayo aññāṇaṃ adassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.sn46.56:4.5: Ekamekenapi kho, bhante, nīvaraṇena abhibhūto yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya, ko pana vādo pañcahi nīvaraṇehi?
segments.sn46.56:5.1: “Katamo pana, bhante, hetu, katamo paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya?
segments.sn46.56:5.2: Kathaṃ sahetu, sappaccayo ñāṇaṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti?
segments.sn46.56:5.3: “Idha, rājakumāra, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn46.56:5.4: So satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati – ayampi kho, rājakumāra, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya.
segments.sn46.56:5.6: Evampi sahetu, sappaccayo ñāṇaṃ dassanaṃ hoti.
segments.sn46.56:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, rājakumāra, bhikkhu … pe … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn46.56:6.3: So upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena yathābhūtaṃ jānāti passati – ayampi kho, rājakumāra, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo ñāṇāya dassanāya.
segments.sn46.56:6.5: Evaṃ sahetu, sappaccayo ñāṇaṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
segments.sn46.56:7.5: Ekamekenapi kho, bhante, bojjhaṅgena samannāgato yathābhūtaṃ jāneyya passeyya, ko pana vādo sattahi bojjhaṅgehi?
segments.sn46.56:7.6: Yopi me, bhante, gijjhakūṭaṃ pabbataṃ ārohantassa kāyakilamatho cittakilamatho, sopi me paṭippassaddho, dhammo ca me abhisamito”ti.

lines: Sopi me paṭippassaddhoti tassa kira satthu santike sītalaṃ utusappāyaṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā nisinnassa kāyadaratho paṭipassambhi, tasmiṃ paṭipassaddhe tadanvayeneva cittadarathopi.
Apica maggenevassa etaṃ ubhayampi passaddhanti veditabbaṃ.
Ekaṃsena bhagavā nīvaraṇāti ekaṃsato eva bhagavā ete dhammā nīvaraṇā citte kusalappavattiyā nīvaraṇato.
Kāyakilamathoti kāyaparissamo, so pana aṭṭhuppattiyā paccayattā “daratho”ti vutto.
